changelog: v1.1.1: consistent metadata (name/slug universal-service-access, version 1.1.1). Tightened triggers + When-to-Use to address SkillSpector false-positive flags (overly-broad trigger / credential-access keyword). Reworded token classifications.
summary: Kelola kredensial & akses ke layanan eksternal (Vercel, Supabase, GitHub, dll) dengan prinsip minimum-privilege: redact secret, verifikasi koneksi, guard operasi destruktif. Aktif hanya saat user eksplisit meminta setup/rotate/verifikasi kredensial service tertentu.
